blocks.text: You can add action rules to apply sensitivity labels from Microsoft Purview Information Protection (formerly Microsoft Information Protection) to files within Azure file shares and on-premises SMB and NFS file shares.
Sensitivity labels configured with user-defined permissions cannot be applied automatically. Such labels require manual intervention, which is currently not supported by action rules.
Before adding an action rule, you must enable the following:

blocks.item: Azure File Share Service
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Cloud Accounts.
Click Manage, and select Manage Services.
On the Manage services to monitor page, select the Leverage MIP Label checkbox.
See image.
To learn more, see Managing Services.
On-Premises File Share
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > SaaS Applications.
Click Add SaaS Tenant.
The Add SaaS Tenant drawer appears.
In the Add SaaS Tenant drawer:
Tenant Information:
Tenant Type: Select Microsoft 365.
Tenant Alias: Enter a unique name for the tenant.
Tenant Name: Enter the name of the tenant.
Tenant ID: Enter the ID of the tenant.
Configuration Details:
Services: Select MIP Label.
See image.
To learn more, see Onboarding Microsoft 365 Tenant.

blocks.text: DSPM scans and discovers the Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels every 12 hours. After you create and enable an action rule, DSPM applies the labels every 4 hours.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Action Rules.
Click Add Action Rule.
See image.
The Create Action Rule page appears.
On the Create Action Rule page, in the General Information section:
Select the Cloud Type: Select a cloud type.
Rule Name: Enter a unique name for the action rule.
Rule Priority: Enter a value to set the rule priority which determines the order for applying rules. The value can range from 1 to 2,000. A lower value (e.g., 1) indicates a higher priority.
(Optional) Rule Description: Enter a description for the action rule.
See image.
Click Next.
In the Configuration section:
Azure
Scope: Select the filters to define the scope for the action rule.
Tenant: Select an Azure File Share tenant from the drop-down menu.
See image.
Azure File Share: Select one or more files from the drop-down menu.
See image.
File Types: Select the file types (e.g., .pdf, .xps, .docx) from the drop-down menu.
See image.
DSPM overrides any previously assigned labels for files that fall within its scope.
Criteria: Select the filters to define the criteria for the action rule.
DLP Engines: Select the DLP engines (e.g., PCI, GLBA) from the drop-down menu.
See image.
Document Types: Select the document types (e.g., Generic HR document, Financial Reports) from the drop-down menu.
See image.
Action: Select the action type and label:
Type: Select Apply Label.
Label: Select the required label.
See image.
On-Premises
Scope: Select the filters to define the scope for the action rule.
File Servers: Select one or more file servers from the drop-down menu.
See image.
File Shares: Select one or more file shares from the drop-down menu.
See image.
File Types: Select the file types (e.g., .pdf, .xps, .docx) from the drop-down menu.
See image.
Criteria: Select the filters to define the criteria for the action rule.
DLP Engines: Select the DLP engines (e.g., PCI, GLBA) from the drop-down menu.
See image.
Document Types: Select the document types (e.g., Technical, Financial Reports) from the drop-down menu.
See image.
Action: Select the action type and label:
Tenant: Select an on-premises tenant from the drop-down menu.
See image.
Type: Select Apply Label.
See image.
Label: Select the required label.
See image.
Click Finish.
The action rule is displayed on the Action Rules page. By default, the action rule is disabled. Click the toggle to enable the action rule.
See image.
